display_long_description:
Enter a high-tension containment facility where every decision matters and every mistake can end the run.

SCP Breach Event throws you into a dangerous research complex where unknown anomalies have escaped containment. Your goal is simple on paper but far from easy in practice: survive, explore, and restore control before everything collapses.

Movement is fully built around Gorilla Tag locomotion, allowing you to climb, swing, and move through the environment in a physical and immersive way that makes every chase and escape feel real. You are not simply walking through corridors—you are moving through them with your own hands.

Progress through the facility is controlled by hand scanners. Certain doors and restricted areas require you to place your hand on a scanner before access is granted. Exploring deeper into the complex will lead you to new sections, hidden rooms, and increasingly dangerous containment zones. Every door could provide a safe route forward or reveal something deadly waiting on the other side.

The game is designed with high-quality visuals and an immersive atmosphere that brings the containment facility to life.
